description: This file defines the DigitalProductService interface, which extends the SalesManagerEntityService interface and declares methods for managing digital products, such as saving, updating, adding files, and retrieving digital products by product and store.

classes.name: DigitalProductService
classes.description: Service interface for managing digital products, providing methods to save, update, add files, and retrieve digital products associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a DigitalProduct instance, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: addProductFile
methods.description: Associates an input content file with a product and digital product, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct by merchant store and product, may throw ServiceException.
